whatsNew:
• Turn your iPhone on its side on Play: scenes on one side, pedals on the other.
• Save from the app over Bluetooth or USB, with no computer.
• Quick build: on an empty preset, tap the blocks you want and the app builds the chain.
• Over Bluetooth, knobs follow the unit, and you get output and scene levels.
• Axe-Fx III: pick NAM captures, and browse and get new ones from TONE3000.
• Metronome: choose where it clicks, flash the screen edge, and line it up with your unit.
• Apple Watch: order its pages, a new Tempo page, and quick edit with the Digital Crown.

notesNew:
New in 2.0.0:
• Turn the iPhone on its side on Play: scenes on one half, the chain on the other.
• With a unit over Bluetooth or USB: Save, Quick build on an empty preset, knobs that follow the unit, output and scene levels.
• TONE3000 (tone3000.com, a third-party library of amp captures, shown with its permission), Axe-Fx III only: hold a NAM block on Play, tap TONE3000. Sign-in is TONE3000's own page. Once signed in, Settings, My rig, TONE3000 signs out. The demo has no NAM block.
• Metronome choices in Settings.
• Apple Watch: page order, a Tempo page, quick edit with the Digital Crown.
testedOn: Tested on: iPhone 17 Pro Max, iOS 27.2.1; Apple Watch Ultra 2.
